resistances.name: piercing & slashing from nonmagical attacks not made w/silvered weapons

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede its darkvision.

entries.name: Phrenic Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon extra 4d6 psychic (included below).

entries.name: Weaken Resolve
entries: Its speech has subtle enchantments that make it seem logical or profound regardless of words used. It has advantage on Cha (Deception) and Cha (Persuasion) checks vs. Humanoids. Also if tutor spends 1+ min conversing with Humanoid that creature has disadvantage on saves vs. tutor's Fiendish Indoctrination and vs. enchantment spells tutor casts.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Claws or Tutor's Batons or one Claw and two Tutor's Batons. It can replace one attack with Spellcasting.

entries.name: Claw (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) slashing damage + 14 (4d6) psychic.

entries.name: Tutor's Baton
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 14 (4d6) psychic. Instead of dealing psychic damage tutor can cause target to be incapacitated until target's next turn ends.

entries.name: Fiendish Indoctrination
entries: Speaks fiendish ideals couched in persuasive scholarly language. Each creature within 30' of tutor: 45 (13d6) psychic and is charmed for 1 min (DC 18 Cha half damage isn't charmed). Charmed creature isn't under tutor's control but regards tutor as a trusted friend taking tutor's requests or actions in most favorable way it can. Charmed creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. A creature that fails the save by 5+ is charmed for 1 day instead. Such a creature can re-save only when it suffers harm or receives a suicidal command ending effect on a success.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Cha (DC 18) no material components: At will: bane calm emotions command detect thoughts suggestion3/day ea: bestow curse compulsion enthrall1/day ea: geas modify memory

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: Magically transforms into a Small or Med Humanoid or back into its true fiendish form. Its stats other than its size are same in each form. Items worn/carried aren't transformed. Reverts on death.

entries.name: Strength of Character
entries: When it succeeds on a save tutor responds with scathing magical insult if source of effect is a creature within 60' of tutor. That creature: DC 18 Wis save or take 14 (4d6) psychic and have disadvantage on next save it makes vs. a spell cast by tutor.

spells.name: bane calm emotions command detect thoughts suggestion

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source
